name: wf-linear
description: wf tracker-provider pack: the linear capability owning the wf capability-registry's tracker surface (Linear issue get/create/update/list-children/comment/status/attachment bindings and status/milestone/cycle queries via mcp__claude_ai_Linear__* tools). A second, independent binding of the tracker contract alongside wf-ado. Ships /wf-linear:init as a compatibility alias — it seeds wf-linear into /wf:init's selection round and relays that lifecycle's own result, registering nothing itself.
